# MenuSifu BBQ Restaurant
> MenuSifu BBQ is a North American barbecue restaurant website built with Bootstrap.
> This site introduces restaurant information, menu, gallery and contact details for customers.

## Website Overview
This is a static restaurant website developed with Bootstrap5.
Pages include homepage, about us, photo gallery and contact page.

## Important Pages
- [Homepage](https://bbq.huoban.men/)
- [About Us](https://bbq.huoban.men/about.html)
- [Gallery](https://bbq.huoban.men/gallery.html)
- [Contact](https://bbq.huoban.men/contact.html)

## Site Technical Info
- Static HTML + Bootstrap5
- Sitemap: https://bbq.huoban.men/sitemap.xml
